title: Climate and Economic Justice Screening Tool (cloud-native formats)
description: The Justice40 initiative and CEJST were announced in the Executive Order on Tackling the Climate Crisis at Home and Abroad in January 2021. The CEJST includes interactive maps and an initial draft scorecard which federal agencies can use to prioritize historically overburdened and underserved communities for benefits in their programs. https://screeningtool.geoplatform.gov/, https://github.com/usds/justice40-tool
